requirements.title: Sandbox Metrics Collection
requirements.description: Collect and expose metrics for sandbox count, disk usage, size distribution, operation latencies, and success rates. Support standard monitoring integrations.

validation.notes: Test metric collection for counters (created, stopped, approved, rejected, deleted, errors, gc runs)
Test gauge metrics (active sandboxes, disk usage, process count)
Test latency tracking for create and diff operations
Verify Prometheus format export with correct metric types and help text
Test latency ring buffer handles overflow correctly
Default collector singleton is available and functional
